ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a large triangle MPO, point Q is on side MP, and point N is on side MO. Segment QN connects the left and right sides, and the base is PO; QN and PO have the same arrow markings, indicating QN ∥ PO. The figure marks MQ = 5, MN = 6, NO = 3 3/5, the lower segment on the left QP is labeled x, and the problem asks to find MP. Reasoning: Because QN ∥ PO, the small triangle MQN is similar to the large triangle MPO. Corresponding sides are proportional: MQ/MP = MN/MO. First find MO = MN + NO = 6 + 3 3/5 = 6 + 18/5 = 48/5. Therefore MN/MO = 6/(48/5) = 6 × 5/48 = 5/8. So MQ/MP = 5/8. Given MQ = 5, therefore 5/MP = 5/8, solving gives MP = 8. Final answer: 8
